articles.title: Melhor notebook para estudar: o que avaliar antes da compra • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Resumo
- O tipo de uso define as especificações do notebook; para uso básico, como navegação e pacote Office, configurações intermediárias atendem bem.
- As especificações técnicas, como processador, memória RAM, GPU e armazenamento, definem o desempenho do notebook.
- O Dell 14, Dell 2 em 1 Inspiron 14 e Dell 15 são opções de notebooks que oferecem bom desempenho, tela e portabilidade para estudos.
Escolher um notebook para estudar muitas vezes começa por uma pergunta simples: para que ele será usado? Por isso, a compra não deve partir apenas do preço ou de características físicas, como tamanho e peso, mas também de especificações como processador e bateria.
Um aparelho errado pode causar travamentos durante pesquisas, incompatibilidade com plataformas e ter que lidar com um equipamento obsoleto antes mesmo da formatura. Para que o investimento valha a pena, a decisão precisa ser baseada nas exigências reais da sua rotina. Entenda o que considerar ao comprar um novo notebook para estudos.
O que avaliar antes de comprar um notebook para estudos
Vale entender o tipo de uso: aulas por vídeo, trabalhos em texto, planilhas, apresentações, leitura, programação, edição de vídeos ou outros softwares específicos do curso. Alguns pontos já ajudam a filtrar a escolha:
- Desempenho: processador, memória RAM e armazenamento definem a fluidez do sistema.
- Tela: tamanho, resolução e conforto visual pesam em longos períodos de leitura.
- Bateria: importante para quem estuda fora de casa ou passa o dia entre aulas.
- Portabilidade: notebooks menores são mais fáceis de levar na mochila.
- Conexões: portas USB, HDMI, entrada para fone e leitor de cartão evitam depender de adaptadores.
- Formato de uso: um modelo 2 em 1 pode ser útil para leitura, anotações e apresentações.
Uso e compatibilidade
O tipo de curso deve orientar a configuração. Para navegação, pacote Office, PDFs e outras plataformas básicas, um notebook com configurações intermediárias já pode atender bem. Entretanto, programação, edição de imagem e vídeo e modelagem 3D, por exemplo, exigem mais poder de processamento e gráfico.
Especificações técnicas
Após entender o tipo de uso, vale olhar para alguns pontos principais: processador, memória RAM, GPU e armazenamento. Eles que definem como o notebook vai lidar bem com multitarefa, arquivos pesados e os programas acessados.
- Processador: define a capacidade do notebook para lidar com tarefas simultâneas e programas. Linhas como Intel Core 3/Core i3 atendem usos diários, como navegador, edição de texto e aulas online. Para tarefas que demandam mais processamento, vale priorizar processadores com mais núcleos e maior fôlego, como configurações das linhas Intel Core 5/Core i5 ou Core 7/Core i7.
- Gráficos: GPUs integradas atendem bem ao uso acadêmico comum, incluindo videochamadas, reprodução de mídia e tarefas de edição.
- Memória RAM: ajuda o notebook a manter vários programas e abas abertos ao mesmo tempo. 8 GB podem atender uma rotina básica de estudos, enquanto 16 GB oferecem mais fôlego para multitarefa.
- Armazenamento: o SSD deve ser prioridade, porque deixa a inicialização do sistema, a abertura e gravação de arquivos mais rápidas. 256 GB podem funcionar para quem usa bastante serviços de nuvem, mas opções a partir de 512 GB são ideais pois permitem instalar mais programas e salvar arquivos sem depender tanto de armazenamento externo.
Tela e construção
Como estudar no computador envolve passar horas lendo e digitando, o conforto também precisa entrar na decisão.
- Tela: modelos de 14 polegadas favorecem mobilidade e cabem melhor na mochila. Já modelos com telas maiores oferecem mais espaço para multitarefas e reprodução de mídia. Em qualquer tamanho, vale priorizar resolução Full HD, acabamento antirreflexo e recursos de conforto visual, como redução de luz azul.
- Teclado e touchpad: teclas bem espaçadas ajudam a reduzir erros em trabalhos longos. Para cursos de exatas, o teclado numérico pode agilizar cálculos e planilhas. O touchpad precisa ter boa resposta para facilitar o uso em sala de aula, biblioteca ou deslocamentos.
- Formato 2 em 1: pode fazer sentido para quem lê muitos textos, faz anotações, apresenta trabalhos ou prefere alternar entre notebook e tablet. É um formato mais flexível, especialmente para aulas e estudos fora da mesa.
Bateria de longa duração
A bateria é uma parte extremamente importante nessa equação. O ideal é buscar aparelhos capazes de entregar pelo menos cerca de oito horas de uso real.
Considere, também, o carregamento: modelos como o Dell 14 e o Dell 15 contam com ExpressCharge, recurso que permite recarregar até 80% da bateria em 60 minutos.
Outro ponto é a eficiência do sistema e da construção. Dispositivos com boa distribuição de calor e recursos para ajustar energia e temperatura conforme o uso ajudam a manter o desempenho mais estável ao longo do dia.
Conectividade e webcam
Um notebook com boas conexões evita que o estudante dependa de adaptadores para tarefas simples, como conectar um pendrive, usar fones de ouvido, projetar uma apresentação ou transferir arquivos de um cartão SD.
Entre as conexões mais úteis estão:
- USB-A: para pendrives, mouse, teclado e acessórios comuns.
- USB-C: para transferência de dados e, em alguns modelos, vídeo ou alimentação.
- HDMI: para monitores, TVs e projetores.
- Entrada para fone de ouvido: útil em aulas online e chamadas.
- Leitor de cartão SD: facilita a transferência de fotos, vídeos e outros arquivos.
Já a qualidade da webcam e do microfone influenciará diretamente em aulas remotas, reuniões em grupo e apresentações online. Considere dispositivos com webcam HD e recursos de redução de ruído no microfone.
Melhores notebooks para estudo
Dell 14
O Dell 14 é um modelo de 14 polegadas, com 1,56 kg de peso e um formato mais fácil de transportar, ideal para quem precisa levar o aparelho para aulas e trabalho.
A tela chega à resolução 2,5K, com brilho de 300 nits, o que ajuda na leitura e videochamadas. O notebook também traz webcam FHD com redução de ruído temporal, áudio Dolby Atmos.
Pode ser encontrado em versões de 8 GB a 32 GB de RAM DDR5 e 512 GB a 1 TB de armazenamento, com processadores Intel Core 5 120U ou Intel Core 7 150U.
Conheça todos os detalhes do Dell 14 no site da Dell.
Dell 2 em 1 Inspiron 14
O Dell 2 em 1 Inspiron 14 é uma opção para quem quer alternar entre notebook e tablet. O formato é útil para rotinas de muita leitura, revisão de textos e anotações, já que permite usar o mesmo aparelho em diferentes posições.
O dispositivo tem opções de 8 GB a 16 GB de memória RAM DDR5, com 512 GB ou 1 TB de armazenamento.
Veja as especificações do Dell 2 em 1 Inspiron 14.
Dell 15
O Dell 15 é a alternativa para quem prefere uma tela maior e teclado mais completo. A tela Full HD de 15,6 polegadas tem acabamento antirreflexo, e o ComfortView ajuda a reduzir a emissão de luz azul em usos prolongados.
O modelo também traz teclado espaçoso, teclado numérico separado e atalho para calculadora, recursos úteis para planilhas, cálculos e trabalhos longos.
Nas configurações disponíveis, o Dell 15 pode vir com processadores Intel Core i5 e Core i7, além de memória DDR5 de até 16 GB e SSD de 512 GB ou 1 TB.
Saiba mais sobre o Dell 15 no site da Dell.

articles.title: NVIDIA GeForce NOW Gets DLSS 4.5 Settings, Steam Machine Support and New Games
articles.text:
Tuesday, August 25th 2026
	
		
	
	
	
NVIDIA GeForce NOW Gets DLSS 4.5 Settings, Steam Machine Support and New Games
NVIDIA is adding a bunch of new features to GeForce NOW, giving subscribers more control over streaming quality while expanding support to more devices. In case you missed it, NVIDIA's GeForce NOW cloud gaming service lets users stream PC games they already own to pretty much anything with a screen, including old PCs, Macs, Steam Deck, phones, tablets and TVs. Supported games can run with ray tracing, path tracing and DLSS 4.5, while some fast-paced titles can be streamed at up to 360 FPS.
One of the more interesting additions is a new set of new DLSS 4.5 controls. NVIDIA says these will give users more control over how supported games look and perform, with options covering DLSS Super Resolution, Dynamic Frame Generation and Ray Reconstruction. Steam support is also getting another boost, and NVIDIA says that Steam Controller support is coming later this year for Steam Deck and Steam Machines, followed by Windows and macOS support.In addition, NVIDIA is also adding GOG single sign-on, which allows users to link their account once, sync supported games and launch them without having to go through the login process every time. NVIDIA is also officially supporting Firefox, giving users another browser option for accessing GeForce NOW. The company is expanding its TV support as well with more Fire TV Stick devices will be supported later this year, including the new Fire TV Stick 4K Select. Amazon is also getting deeper into the picture. Fire TV users will be able to buy a GeForce NOW membership directly through Amazon, keeping the subscription and setup process inside their existing Amazon account.
And NVIDIA is already lining up some big games for the service. Several major PC releases coming this year, including CONTROL Resonant, Gears of War: E-Day, Onimusha: Way of the Sword, The Blood of Dawnwalker and STAR WARS Zero Company, which are all expected to be available on GeForce NOW from day one.
NVIDIA said that more information will be available later this week.

articles.title: Hot Chips 2026: Nvidia breaks down Vera CPU — spatial multithreading benchmarked, agentic workloads detailed, and more
articles.text:
Hot Chips 2026: Nvidia breaks down 88-core Vera CPU — spatial multithreading benchmarked, 1.2 TB/s SOCAMM2 memory, agentic workloads detailed, and more
Plus a deployment at SpaceXAI.
This Tom's Hardware Premium article is free to read with a Tom's Hardware account; no payment necessary. We're offering free access from August 23 to 26 so you can read all of our reporting from Hot Chips.
Nvidia has spent the last several months providing key disclosures about its next-gen Vera CPU for agentic data centers, which it continued at Hot Chips 2026. Although we've already learned a lot about Vera, how it compares to AMD's next-gen Venice CPUs, and the inner workings of the Olympus core, Nvidia provided a bit more color at Hot Chips on spatial multithreading, the memory subsystem, and what types of workloads it's targeting with Vera.
As a quick refresher, Vera is the first CPU with a custom Nvidia core, following up on Grace, which used a stock Arm design. It's shipping as a single, 88-core SKU, and it has some key design differences compared to Nvidia's x86 competition, most notably a multi-threading implementation that Nvidia calls spatial multi-threading, an LPDDR5X memory subsystem, and a monolithic compute die rather than using compute chiplets.
Nvidia says it's designed Vera specifically for agentic AI workloads, a category that's still being defined in terms of performance benchmarking. Many CPU-intensive tasks serve as proxies for agentic workloads (i.e., code compilation), though measuring performance across a full agentic chain is complex and inconsistent. Nvidia, in its own slides (see the end of this article), calls agentic AI the "most complex computing workload in history," after all.
Nvidia provided an example of a headless browser to show the benefits of Vera, using optimized code to mimic how an agent would use a browser. Compared to the 96-core EPYC 9655P, Nvidia says Vera runs 24% faster as browser instances scale.
This slide is a good demonstration of the complexities in measuring traditional workloads and applying that performance to agentic workflows. Agents will often fetch websites for information, but there are several layers where agents can trim back compared to humans; in this case, agents can run through a browsing workflow 4.5x faster by cutting things like GUI rendering, fonts, media decoding, and more.
Another touchstone for agentic performance is code compilation, as agents seek out software to compile on the system. This might be the most direct benchmark of agentic AI performance with current workflows right now. Though, as previously mentioned, agentic chains are long, complex, and involve several different workloads.
Once again, compared to the 96-core EPYC 9655P, Nvidia claims Vera can compile the Linux kernel 22% faster with a native AArch64 target, and 14% faster when cross-compiling for x86.
Nvidia's big cores for agentic AI — another look at Olympus and how it fits into Vera
Nvidia reiterated the importance of the large cores inside Vera, including the large BPU, neural branch predictor, and 10-wide decode. Nvidia has previously disclosed the Olympus core architecture, which you can read about in our Vera deep dive. Broadly speaking, however, it's a wide core optimized for high single-core throughput.
One of the more interesting design points of Vera is spatial multi-threading, which Nvidia described in more detail during its Hot Chips 2026. In short, Nvidia separates core resources on two pipelines, though data and cache can move between threads as needed. To demonstrate the benefit, Nvidia shared the results from SPEC CPU 2017 intrate that you can see below.
This shows the "noisy neighbor" effect. Nvidia measured single-core performance and then measured the same workload with another thread active. Nvidia's data shows that Vera is less concerned with the neighboring thread, whereas a "traditional CPU" sees a larger slowdown. Nvidia didn't clarify which CPU it's comparing Vera to here, however.
Nvidia's slide does a good job illustrating, but it's worth noting the difference compared to traditional SMT nonetheless. With traditional SMT, resources are time-sliced between threads, leading to gaps between BP and decode, as illustrated in the slide. With spatial multithreading in Vera, threads are still fighting for resources within the core. However, spatial multithreading allows Nvidia to deal with the demand of neighboring threads in a deterministic way, leading to a more consistent downturn in per-core performance when the second thread is working.
Nvidia's second-gen Scalable Coherency Fabric (SCF) moves data across the die. Nvidia didn't provide any new disclosures around SCF at Hot Chips, but you can see how the fabric is laid out in the slide below. Centralized Coherency Switch Nodes (CSNs) connect the cores to pools of L3 cache totaling 164 MB and the broader memory subsystem.
At a system level, one of the more interesting choices Nvidia made was to use LPDDR5X as opposed to traditional RDIMMs, a choice that it was only able to make due to the serviceable SOCAMM2 design. Nvidia includes eight SOCAMM2 slots per Vera CPU on a board, offering up to 1.5 TB of capacity with 1.2 TB/s of bandwidth.
LPDDR5X can deliver transfer rates higher than DDR5 RDIMMs, at least compared to single-rank DIMMs. However, it seems the driving force behind LPDDR5X wasn't performance but rather power consumption. One of the pillars of Vera, according to Nvidia's Hot Chips presentation, was to deliver a CPU for power-limited data centers. Micron says its LPDDR5X consumes about a third of the power compared to a traditional RDIMM.
Nvidia demonstrated that point a little differently, using bandwidth per watt as a point of comparison between the LPDDR5X system in Vera and traditional RDIMMs. This illustration does the job, though it could be a bit misleading, measuring power draw against peak bandwidth.
Nvidia tells us that a fully loaded memory system with Vera consumes between 30W and 40W, with 1.5 TB at 9600 MT/s. Power demands for RDIMMs vary wildly depending on capacity, channels, and transfer rate, though power consumption can easily climb over 100W depending on the configuration.
Although Nvidia has deployed Grace in the data center — to the tune of "hundreds of thousands" of standalone servers, apparently — Vera represents Nvidia's first big push to gobble up market share in the expanding agentic CPU market. It's highly targeted, as evidenced by the fact that Nvidia is only delivering a single 88-core SKU, and it's already being put to use in large-scale deployments, with Nvidia announcing yesterday a deployment of Vera at SpaceXAI.
Nvidia has shared the slide above before, which it once again showed at Hot Chips 2026. It's normalizing per-core performance in SPEC CPU 2026 against the AMD EPYC 9755. The core differences explain the big disparity in numbers; in reality, Vera led in overall score by 3%. Regardless, this is the slide Nvidia is using to pitch Vera, claiming it offers a big improvement in the workloads that are most relevant for agentic AI.
The most formidable opponent for Vera isn't Turin, however. It's Venice, which AMD launched in June, and Diamond Rapids, which Intel detailed just moments after Nvidia left the stage. Vera has a lot of interesting talking points already, but it'll be interesting to watch how Nvidia scales (or doesn't scale) its data center CPU business over the next few generations. Perhaps we'll see the firm double down on these agentic workflows, or maybe concessions and product segmentation to appeal to hyperscalers. Time will tell.

articles.title: El dueño de un montón de locales en Barna se queja de que los vecinos han tomado medidas: poner muñecos de vudú en las puertas
articles.text:
Blaise Thorens abre cada mañana su local y, desde hace unos días, ejerce un ritual: comprobar si alguien ha dejado algo de brujería en la puerta. "Al abrir por la mañana nos encontramos muñecos de vudú", reconoció él mismo hace unas semanas. También se ha topado con velas, monedas, pintadas en las persianas y coches vandalizados, según confirmó en dos entrevistas. Bienvenidos a la guerra silenciosa contra el "brunch" en Barcelona.
El imperio de las tortitas. Thorens, suizo de 39 años, aterrizó en Barcelona hace una década. Abrió su primer Billy Brunch en 2018 en el número 115 de la calle Bailén, cuando el concepto de tostada de aguacate a seis euros sonaba extraño en español. Antes fue manager de conferencias y banquetes para W Barcelona y antes manager en varios restaurantes. Desde entonces, la carta de infusiones detox o retox, pancakes y munchies ha crecido igual que su oferta de locales.
Hoy tiene 10 locales: 6 en Barcelona (como el de la calle de Blai, 28). Y, 2 en Madrid y 2 en Sevilla, con casi 200 empleados y un objetivo declarado de llegar a 50 locales y mil trabajadores. Solo en la calle Bailén, entre Mallorca y Valencia, controla tres esquinas seguidas: los números 113, 115 y 129. Su última apuesta, un brunch con piscina de bolas y tobogán, se ha convertido en fenómeno viral en cuestión de semanas.
¿Y los vecinos? La Dreta de l'Eixample, donde se concentra Billy Brunch, es zona cero de la turistificación barcelonesa. El distrito acumula 3.251 pisos turísticos de los 7.531 que tiene registrados toda la ciudad, y los vecinos llevan denunciando desde 2024 ante la Sindicatura de Greuges de Catalunya un proceso de gentrificación acelerada: 74 fincas ya identificadas en transformación hacia vivienda de lujo o de temporada. Un estudio de la Universitat de Barcelona documentó desahucios invisibles —es decir, sin proceso judicial— mediante subidas de alquiler o la práctica del moving, diseñada para que el inquilino se marche por decisión "propia".
En ese contexto, un negocio que ocupa tres locales seguidos en la misma manzana, genera colas que bloquean la acera y salta el límite de mesas en terraza los fines de semana —según denuncias vecinales recogidas en Reddit—, son el símbolo perfecto de todo lo que el barrio siente que ha perdido. Y, ante un símbolo, otro más arcaico. Y aunque la Ley de Espectáculos Públicos catalana reconoce multas que van de 601 a 600.000 euros según gravedad, es harto complicado abrir un acta o cerrar una terraza que puede desplegarse y replegarse en minutos.
Quién anda detrás. No se sabe, pero sí que desde 2023, la asamblea Assemblea de Barris pel Decreixement Turístic convoca manifestaciones anuales bajo el lema explícito "No al brunch, decreixement turístic ja". El brunch se ha convertido en sinécdoque de la turistificación: no por lo que se come, sino por a quién representa, al expatriado con poder adquisitivo que puede pagar un café de especialidad mientras el vecino de toda la vida no llega a fin de mes con el alquiler. Mientras algunas cafeterías expulsaban a sus vecinos, estos locales son el salón privado de los nómadas digitales.
"Es globalización, no gentrificación". Thorens no se calla. Y rechaza frontalmente ser el chivo expiatorio. "Somos el objetivo. Y lo entiendo, cuando hay odio es porque hay sufrimiento. Pero contrato a 200 personas, pago muchos impuestos". Señala a otros culpables más grandes y menos visibles: los cruceros que "traen 5.000 turistas que como mucho compran un imán", y los grandes tenedores de vivienda que mantienen miles de pisos cerrados intencionadamente para especular con el precio. Y pregunta, además, "¿Por qué la pizza y el ramen no tienen los mismos problemas que el brunch?". No miente: mientras el ramen en Japón sufre una tremenda caída por costes, en España es casi plato símbolo de toda una cultura malentendida.
Un símbolo que (también) viene del imperio. El giro loco muñeco de alfileres que todos asocian al vudú no viene de Haití. Ni de Luisiana o África occidental, sino de conceptos europeos de brujería muy anteriores al contacto colonial. En el vudú haitiano real, las muñecas se colocan junto a tumbas o árboles de kapok para enviar mensajes a los antepasados, no para clavar alfileres. El estereotipo del "muñeco maldito" fue una construcción del imaginario colonial francés y estadounidense, difundida para retratar el vudú como magia negra bárbara y deslegitimar la Revolución haitiana —que, vaya casualidad, fue una de las escasas sublevaciones de esclavos que fundó un Estado libre—, justificando después la ocupación militar de EEUU entre 1915 y 1934.
Empresas como Airbnb no esconden su lenguaje de conquista: hablan de "acelerar la expansión internacional" como pilar estratégico oficial, y su CEO traza en llamadas de resultados un mapa explícito de mercados por capturar —Brasil, México, Japón, India, Corea del Sur— mientras refuerza el "stronghold", literalmente "bastión" o "fortaleza", ya conseguido en Alemania, Italia y España. Vocablos militares aplicados a vivienda. También a franquicias de tortitas. Si los vecinos de la Dreta de l'Eixample despliegan estos símbolos 200 años después, por un lado resignifican una herramienta de propaganda imperialista y, por otro, la globalizan otro poco.

articles.title: Convertir un celular antiguo en un repetidor WiFi sin pagar dinero es muy fácil con este paso a paso
articles.text:
Una solución sencilla y sin pagar dinero para ampliar la cobertura de la red de internet en casa es convertir un celular en un repetidor WiFi. Esta alternativa no exige conocimientos técnicos avanzados ni inversiones adicionales. Incluso celulares antiguos pueden cumplir este rol si cumplen ciertos requisitos básicos.
El proceso se apoya en aplicaciones gratuitas, que simplifican el proceso y eliminan la necesidad de configuraciones complejas. La interfaz guía los pasos y permite aprovechar el hardware disponible para solucionar problemas de cobertura.
PUBLICIDAD
Qué requisitos debe cumplir el celular antiguo para ser un repetidor WiFi
El primer paso consiste en disponer de un dispositivo Android que funcione correctamente y tenga acceso a internet. No es necesario que el dispositivo sea reciente ni que cuente con prestaciones avanzadas, solo que permita instalar aplicaciones desde Google Play Store.
Además, se debe verificar el estado de la batería y la capacidad de conexión WiFi del celular. Un teléfono que mantiene la carga y puede conectarse a redes inalámbricas proporciona una base sólida para transformarse en repetidor.
PUBLICIDAD
Cómo se instala y configura la aplicación en el teléfono antiguo
Se debe descargar NetShare, disponible sin costo en Google Play Store. Esta app convierte el celular antiguo en un punto de acceso WiFi secundario.
Tras la instalación, se debe abrir la aplicación y conectar el dispositivo a la red WiFi principal que se desea ampliar. La interfaz guía de forma intuitiva para activar la opción “Start WiFi Hotspot”. Al seleccionar esta función, el celular comienza a emitir una nueva señal.
PUBLICIDAD
La aplicación genera un nombre de red (SSID) y una contraseña, visibles en pantalla, que permiten conectar otros dispositivos como computadoras, tabletas o más teléfonos. El acceso es inmediato y no requiere modificaciones manuales en la configuración del dispositivo, lo que facilita el uso para cualquier usuario.
De qué forma mejorar el funcionamiento del repetidor WiFi en casa
El lugar donde se coloca el celular repetidor impacta directamente en la calidad de la señal. Se debe ubicar en una zona intermedia entre el router principal y el área donde la cobertura disminuye.
PUBLICIDAD
De este modo, el dispositivo recibe una señal WiFi estable y puede transmitirla a las zonas de la vivienda que requieren mejor acceso. No conviene situar el celular cerca de materiales que bloquean las ondas, como metal, piedra o grandes recipientes de agua.
Asimismo, puede ser necesario reiniciar tanto el router como el celular repetidor si se detectan caídas en la velocidad de conexión. Este procedimiento restablece los parámetros y ayuda a mantener un flujo constante de datos. El reinicio periódico del router contribuye a la estabilidad general de la red doméstica.
PUBLICIDAD
Qué otras estrategias permiten mejorar la velocidad del WiFi en casa
Más allá de la instalación de un repetidor WiFi, existen pautas útiles para optimizar la velocidad de internet. Una de las más efectivas consiste en reiniciar el router de manera regular. Desconectar el aparato, esperar unos segundos y volver a conectarlo elimina problemas temporales y restablece la calidad de la señal.
Otra medida útil es la ubicación del router. Se sugiere posicionarlo en un punto central de la vivienda y evitar sótanos, armarios o proximidad con fuentes de interferencia como microondas, teléfonos inalámbricos o acuarios.
PUBLICIDAD
Cambiar la banda de frecuencia entre 2.4 GHz y 5 GHz puede ofrecer beneficios según la distancia y los obstáculos presentes en el hogar. La banda de 2.4 GHz ofrece mayor alcance, mientras que 5 GHz garantiza mejores velocidades en distancias cortas.
Estas soluciones caseras y fáciles de implementar representan una alternativa para hogares con muchos dispositivos conectados que buscan maximizar el alcance y la calidad de su conexión inalámbrica a internet.

articles.title: iPhone no Brasil ganha recurso para mostrar câmera ao vivo à polícia • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
iPhone no Brasil ganha recurso para mostrar câmera ao vivo à polícia
Apple liberou oficialmente o recurso para usuários no país. Novidade utiliza tecnologia da plataforma RapidSOS para enviar imagens aos atendentes do 190.
Resumo
- Usuários de iPhone no Brasil poderão transmitir vídeos ao vivo para as centrais do 190 durante chamadas de emergência.
- A tecnologia utiliza a plataforma RapidSOS para enviar imagens em tempo real aos atendentes da Polícia Militar, agilizando o envio de viaturas.
- O recurso está disponível para iPhone 14 ou modelos mais recentes e depende da adesão de cada Centro de Operações da Polícia Militar.
Os brasileiros que possuem iPhone ganharam um novo recurso para momentos críticos: a transmissão de vídeo ao vivo direto para o 190. A tecnologia entrega chamadas em tempo real aos atendentes da Polícia Militar para ajudar durante as ocorrências.
O recurso foi liberdo nessa segunda-feira (24/08) no Brasil, mas já existia nos Estados Unidos desde o lançamento do iOS 18. Trata-se de uma colaboração entre a Apple e a plataforma de segurança RapidSOS.
Como funciona a transmissão ao vivo?
A funcionalidade é chamada oficialmente de Vídeo ao Vivo do SOS de Emergência. O interessante é que o processo de gravação não é iniciado pela pessoa que liga, mas sim pelo próprio operador do 190: se o profissional avaliar que imagens podem auxiliar no chamado, ele envia um pedido de compartilhamento de câmera para o celular do usuário, que precisa aceitar ou recusar.
Com um toque na opção de compartilhar, a câmera (traseira ou frontal) é ativada e o vídeo começa a ser enviado para a central. Segundo a Apple, o tráfego de dados é criptografado e o usuário mantém o controle total da ferramenta, podendo pausar ou interromper a transmissão a qualquer momento (o sistema também permite o envio de fotos e vídeos armazenados na galeria do iPhone).
Para que o envio das imagens funcione na prática, o usuário precisa possuir pelo menos um iPhone 14 ou modelo mais recente. Já do lado das autoridades, a operação depende dos módulos do sistema UNITE da RapidSOS, responsáveis por processar as informações e exibi-las aos Centros de Comunicação de Emergência (CCEs).
É diferente do SOS via satélite
O recurso funciona de maneira diferente do já conhecido SOS de Emergência via satélite, criado para pedir socorro em rodovias remotas ou trilhas sem sinal de celular, mas que continua indisponível no Brasil. O compartilhamento de vídeo ao vivo, por outro lado, utiliza dados móveis das operadoras ou conexão Wi-Fi ativa.
O acesso dependerá da adesão de cada Centro de Operações da Polícia Militar (Cecopom). A ferramenta de imagem exige que as centrais locais utilizem painéis de recebimento de vídeo da RapidSOS nas operações. Na prática, a adoção acontecerá de forma gradual, variando de município para município e de estado para estado.
Vale mencionar que a infraestrutura da RapidSOS já atua no país desde 2023, prestando serviços de infraestrutura para integrações como a do aplicativo Uber com o 190 no estado do Rio de Janeiro. A tecnologia permite o envio de dados de viagens, informações do veículo e localização de motoristas para a central policial durante ocorrências acionadas no aplicativo de transporte.

articles.title: The Witcher 3 is getting a major free remaster in September, new expansion arrives in 2027
articles.text:
Something to look forward to: CD Projekt Red had already promised plenty of Witcher news at Gamescom, and it delivered more than expected. The studio has announced The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered, a substantial overhaul launching September 29 as a free upgrade for existing owners. It also provided the first proper look at Songs of the Past, a new paid expansion arriving in 2027.
The Witcher 3 Remastered appears to go considerably further than simply sharpening up the visuals of the 2015 RPG. CD Projekt Red says the new edition will update graphics, performance, combat, movement, progression, and several other parts of the game.
Visual improvements include upgraded textures for environments, characters, and monsters, along with denser foliage and revised lighting, rendering, and ray tracing. Combat is also being reworked with new animations, finishing moves, and a more adaptive camera.
Other changes include improved traversal, revised horse controls, enhanced monster behavior, new Witcher Sign effects, a redesigned skill tree, transmogrification, an expanded photo mode, and cross-platform mod support.
 – The Witcher (@thewitcher) August 25, 2026
The upgrade launches September 29 on PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series. The Witcher 3 will also receive a native Nintendo Switch 2 version, while CD Projekt Red is bringing the game to Battle.net through a new partnership with Blizzard.
Existing owners on eligible platforms will receive Remastered at no additional cost.
CD Projekt Red had another surprise for anyone who only owns the base game. Hearts of Stone and Blood and Wine, the two acclaimed expansions released in 2015 and 2016, are now being made available to existing Witcher 3 owners for free. That means players can revisit essentially the complete current Witcher 3 experience before another major adventure arrives next year.
"Songs of the Past" revealed
CD Projekt Red also showed the first footage from Songs of the Past, The Witcher 3's first new expansion since Blood and Wine a decade ago. The expansion sends Geralt to Letten, a previously unseen region portrayed as a peaceful rural land built around farming, festivals, and local folklore. Naturally, things aren't quite as idyllic as they initially appear, with an old threat lurking beneath the surface.
 – The Witcher (@thewitcher) August 25, 2026
Geralt will encounter new enemies, reconnect with familiar characters, and gain additional abilities. One of the more noticeable additions shown so far is a new chain weapon, which should give Geralt another option for controlling and attacking enemies.
Songs of the Past is being developed by CD Projekt Red alongside Fool's Theory, the Polish studio behind The Thaumaturge. Fool's Theory is also leading development of the remake of the original Witcher. Songs of the Past will be a paid expansion. It will launch sometime in 2027 for PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series, and Nintendo Switch 2.
CD Projekt Red previously indicated that the expansion would be comparable in scope to Blood and Wine, which introduced the large Toussaint region and added dozens of hours of new content.
 – The Witcher (@thewitcher) August 24, 2026
The company plans to reveal considerably more during Gamescom. Five days of Witcher-focused REDstreams are scheduled from August 26 through August 30, including gameplay presentations, interviews, and behind-the-scenes material covering both Remastered and Songs of the Past.
All of this will help fill what remains a fairly long wait for the franchise's next numbered installment.
The Witcher 4, which shifts the spotlight from Geralt to Ciri, is currently targeting a 2028 release. CD Projekt Red co-CEO Michał Nowakowski emphasized that 2028 remains a target rather than a firm launch date, leaving room for the project to move if additional development time is required.
Whenever The Witcher 4 does arrive, it is expected to begin an unusually busy period for the studio. CD Projekt Red has said it wants to release three Witcher games within six years, with its collaboration with Epic Games on Unreal Engine 5 intended to help shorten development cycles between installments.
Beyond The Witcher 4 and the original game's remake, the company has another Witcher project in development, alongside the next Cyberpunk game and an entirely new IP.
For now, though, CD Projekt Red is making its 11-year-old RPG the center of attention again. Between a free overhaul in September and a full expansion next year, The Witcher 3 is getting a much bigger second life than anyone would have expected this far after launch.

articles.title: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls is a phenomenal fighting game hampered by corporate meddling
articles.text:
TechRadar Verdict
I adore Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls. Developer Arc System Works has put together a gloriously fun tag fighter that appeals to both casual and hardcore players — a balancing act few fighting games have managed to achieve. Unfortunately, I fear the PC version might cause the whole thing to come crashing down, and its myriad technical issues need to be addressed as soon as possible.
Pros
- +Story episodes are charming and packed with gorgeous art
- +A wonderful roster of Marvel heroes and villains
- +Excellent training tools
- +Easy to pick up and play, but with a sky-high skill ceiling
Cons
- -PC version is stuffed to the gills with DRM bloatware...
- -... and online play is blocked in well over 100 countries thanks to PSN
- -Ongoing issues with online matchmaking
- -The roster feels a tad cramped at launch
Why you can trust TechRadar
Is Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls one of the best fighting games of recent times? Yes, I would say so. Given its developer is Arc System Works — creators of Guilty Gear, Blazblue, and the excellent Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising — it was a pretty safe bet that we'd be served a high quality fighting game with mountainous respect and reverence for Marvel and its roster of supers, mutants, and weirdos.
Platform reviewed: PC
Available on: PS5, PC
Release date: August 6, 2026
I love fighting games, but I'm not usually one for tag fighters — often because I find learning more than one character intimidating and time-consuming. So, when Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls was first revealed last year as a 4v4 tag fighter, I'd already resigned myself to thinking: 'well, that's probably not for me.'
Not two, not three, but four? You're having a laugh.
I needn't have worried so much. Arc System Works has designed Fighting Souls such that learning a quartet of fighters inside and out is absolutely not necessary. It's possible to play that way at a higher level, of course. But as your team only has a single health bar, you can rock one character as your main, while relying on the remaining three as assist moves to help you out in a pinch.
It helps, too, that Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls has a fantastic onboarding process for new players. The game's story mode is broken into five episodes — each focused on a group of heroes (the Avengers, X-Men, etc.) or the villainous Knights of Doom. Episode chapters are structured to introduce you to fighters and their strengths, or otherwise various important system mechanics. Training tools are similarly great, with a fully-featured training mode, combo trials, and an ingenious 'level-up missions' category that tasks you with creating your own combos to reach a damage threshold.
All good so far, but I unfortunately have to stress that Tokon's immediate future looks perilous. The PC version of the game is currently facing myriad issues, many of which seem to be a direct result of corporate interference.
At the time of writing, Arc System Works is hard at work deploying patches to improve PC matchmaking and performance, but I'm not sure there's a fix for intrusive anti-cheat bloatware and forcing PlayStation Network account creation to access its online features.
Sign up for breaking news, reviews, opinion, top tech deals, and more.
Absolutely champion
Enough doom and gloom for now. I'd rather chat about all the elements that I feel make Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls such a wonderful game for a bit. For me, it started with its single-player story mode.
Titled 'Episodes', Tokon's story is broken into five distinct, well, episodes. Each is centered around one of the game's five main teams. The Fighting Avengers, for example, are your stalwart heroes like Captain America and Black Panther.
The Samurai Outriders are made up of anti-heroes and tricksters like Deadpool and Loki. Meanwhile, the Knights of Doom bring a more villainous flavor, stacked with evildoers like Doctor Doom, Green Goblin, and Carnage.
I'm in love with Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls' eclectic moment-to-moment tag bouts, but a special shoutout has to go to the game's wicked cel-shaded presentation. Marvel icons have been given a distinctly Arc System Works flavor — their appearance, animation, and super move cut-ins are all top-tier stuff.
The premise is simple. An intergalactic fighter called the Champion is holding Earth hostage, and the aforementioned five teams have been selected to participate in a tournament to decide the planet's future. Each episode culminates in a fight with the Champion, and individual chapters are bookended with stunning comic book cutscenes, with each episode even featuring a unique artist and colorist.
This lends all of them a unique sense of identity, and helps to keep things feeling fresh as you progress. Each episode is about an hour long, and all are worth playing through as you'll not only get a feel for each individual character, you will also unlock colors for a bit of added flair for your faves. Oh, and as a bonus, you'll also unlock the Champion as a playable character upon clearing your first episode.
There are a lot of fun character moments, too. Ms. Marvel is often adorably starstruck by the heroes she encounters. The X-Men are flabberghasted that Magneto would team up with an egotistical maniac like Doctor Doom. There's a cute running gag between episodes where everyone gives Loki the side eye, despite a seeming earnestness from the God of Lies to genuinely turn over a new leaf in the search for his brother Thor (who is currently mysteriously absent from the game's playable roster).
Overall, Episodes are a great way to kick off your Tokon journey. It'll help you find characters you enjoy playing, and present a charming story that's well worth playing through just to experience its wonderful artwork and voiced performances.
Assist me
Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls is remarkably easy to just pick up and play, and I reckon you'll have a blast in local play with friends for casual couch bouts. Movement, special moves, assists, and supers are all straightforward to execute. For specials in particular, you have options for simple or motion inputs with the d-pad. Motion-inputted special moves (such as quarter-circle-forward) do around 10% more damage on average, so you'll have a bit of an edge if you can master weaving them into your gameplan.
The 4v4 setup can be wonderfully chaotic; there's no limit to the number of characters that can appear on-screen, so it's very possible to spam the assist button to throw the kitchen sink at your opponent in a pinch.
Characters you place in your assist slots are highly versatile, and can be individually called upon by pressing the assist button and the corresponding direction on the d-pad. One assist slot is for projectile, for example, while another is a vertical for anti-airs. This is universal across the cast, so you don't have to be precious about which characters you choose if you're only planning on maining one or two.
Elsewhere, you can perform an assist counter while guarding to get your opponent off of you, or even swap to one of your assists to directly control them. There's a ton you can do with assists, and learning to incorporate them in your playstyle is a huge part of the learning process. It sounds like a lot, and it is, and there's much more assists can do, like extending your combos and taking part in a massively damaging last round super. It might take a bit to wrap your head around, but thankfully, the tools are there to help you get to grips with assists and more besides.
Trained to perfection
Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls has some of the best tutorialization I've ever seen in a fighting game. You of course have a fully fleshed out training mode, where you can freely practice combos and setups against a dummy. There is also a comprehensive tutorial section known as the Battle Guide, that'll walk you through basics like movement all the way to advanced techniques like wakeup options and blocking cross-ups.
Of particular note is Character Lessons, which includes primers on every character playable in the game. These start off with basic move introductions, as well as the properties of each characters' unique button. For example, Storm's Tempest unique lets her control the wind to push herself and her opponent around. Magik's unique has her placing a portal that she can instantly warp to and perform attack out of to surprise the opponent.
Lessons then offer a selection of combos for you to try out for each character, many weaving in assists, special moves, and supers. Finally, the highlight of Character Lessons for me are the Level-Up Missions, which task you with performing a combo to meet a certain amount of damage. These don't hold your hand much, with little guidance outside of telling you which button to start your combo with, or to include a special move at some point. They're great fun to experiment with, and even unlock colors for your characters, too.
Once you feel sufficiently warmed up, I highly recommend jumping into Arena mode for some offline quickplay. This is essentially the game's Arcade mode, in which you play through a series of five matches. You'll get to choose your route as you go through, unlocking some lovely concept art for your efforts.
There's also Survival mode; a 100-match gauntlet with some light roguelite elements. Between matches in Survival mode, you'll get to choose and upgrade Support Souls — cards that offer various benefits like increased movement speed or attack power. Getting through all 100 is no easy task, though, with several significant difficulty spikes on your way to the top. But again, your efforts will be rewarded with unique character colors if you make it to the end.
True believers
If you're familiar with Arc System Works' back catalog, it should come as no surprise that Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls is a mind-bendingly gorgeous fighting game.
The developer is the master of modern cel-shading, and the roster of Marvel icons look even sharper here than characters do in Guilty Gear Strive and Dragonball FighterZ. Not that those games are slouches at all in the visual department, but Tokon by comparison looks impressively pristine at all times.
There aren't a ton of characters or stages at launch (I personally think 21 characters is a bit slim given the 4v4 setup), but when they look and animate as well as they do, I can forgive the base roster being as svelte as it is by tag fighter standards.
Every character is brimming with personality and charming little touches. Doom's cartoonish aptitude for evil is perfectly captured in his intimidating slow walk and thousand-yard stare. Ms. Marvel's attacks feel peppy, snappy, and excitable. And Deadpool? Well, almost every move in his arsenal is a loving reference to other iconic fighting games, and there are some impressively deep cuts therein.
The game's background stages are a real draw, too. The New York City stage is teeming with detail and references to the wider world of Marvel. The X-Mansion tends to populate the further a match progresses, with iconic X-Men like Psylocke, Colossus, and Gambit appearing in the background. If you're a Marvel head, you'll likely love the amount of respect and admiration Arc System Works has for the brand.
Pride before a fall
Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls is another slam-dunk for Arc System Works, then. With it and the recent Marvel vs. Capcom Fighting Collection: Arcade Classics compilation, I'm ecstatic to see Marvel active again in the realm of fighting games. But every story has its villain, and for Tokon, it's not the Champion. It's Sony.
I hate to admit that I'm concerned for Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls' future. On PC, the game's anti-cheat DRM worsens performance. Furthermore, Linux and mod support are non-starters, and because online play requires a PlayStation Network account, countries where the service isn't supported (there are well over 100 of them) can't access network features at all. Throw in lopsided netcode that discourages crossplay between PS5 and PC, and you have a recipe for an exceptionally messy launch month largely thanks to publisher meddling.
For these reasons, I can't give Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls a glowing recommendation, as much as I would like to. At least if you were planning to pick up the game on PC. I want Tokon to have a long, bright future, but I worry that too much damage has already been done. Now, the state of the game has improved since launch in regards to performance and matchmaking quality, thanks to a small handful of fixes deployed by Arc System Works.
I just can't help but feel anxious about this rocky PC launch. Especially with the recent news that Riot Games is shuttering development on its League of Legends fighting game, 2XKO. It shows that huge companies absolutely aren't afraid to completely tear down a good thing if it isn't generating satisfactory revenue or player count. If folks walk away from Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls because of the issues it's facing on PC, then what's stopping Sony from doing the same?
I hope I'm just overthinking it. Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls is one of the most fun and unique fighting games I've played in some time, and I hope its candle won't be snuffed out before it truly gets the chance to shine its brightest.
Should I play Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls?
Play it if...
You love the Marvel tag fighters of old
Living up to Marvel vs. Capcom's legacy is no easy task. And while Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls is doing its own thing with its own roster, it's nonetheless continued proof that Marvel and tag fighters are a winning combination.
You're completely new to fighting games
Learning fighting games can be daunting, and Tokon certainly has a high skill ceiling with its tagging and various system mechanics. But elements like auto combos, easy special move inputs, and a recognizable roster of Marvel icons make this game incredibly newcomer-friendly.
Don't play it if...
You want the PC version
This hopefully won't be a dealbreaker for long especially with the impressive pace Arc System Works is deploying fixes. But PC performance and matchmaking issues are still ongoing, and it may be worth waiting a few months for the Steam version to catch up with its PS5 counterpart in overall quality.
Accessibility features
At launch, Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls has a small handful of accessibility features, largely utilizing text-to-speech options.
You can enable text-to-speech and adjust its volume and speed. You can also choose to enable or disable subtitles that display during battle entrances and conclusions.
How I reviewed Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls
I played Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls on PC for approximately 15 hours for this review. I completed the episodic story mode in its entirety, cleared most Arcade mode routes, and put a good chunk of hours into training mode, character lesson guides, and casual online play.
I tested the game with the GameSir G7 Pro controller, as well as the leverless Razer Kitsune. I also hooked up my RIG 900 Max HS gaming headset to experience the game's excellent audio and wonderfully upbeat soundtrack.
First reviewed August 2026
Rhys is TRG's Hardware Editor, and has been part of the TechRadar team for over four years. Particularly passionate about high-quality third-party controllers and headsets, Rhys strives to provide easy-to-read, informative coverage on gaming hardware of all kinds. As for the games themselves, Rhys is especially keen on fighting and racing games, as well as soulslikes and RPGs.

articles.title: Germany’s Infineon is acquiring Bengaluru’s C2i Semiconductors
articles.text:
Germany’s Infineon is acquiring Bengaluru’s C2i Semiconductors
Infineon’s acquisition of C2i strengthens its AI data-centre power-management capabilities, combining digital power expertise with semiconductor scale as rising AI workloads intensify electricity and power-delivery challenges.
German company Infineon Technologies is acquiring Bengaluru-based C2i Semiconductors as it seeks to strengthen its capabilities in power management for AI data centres. The transaction is expected to close in the third quarter of 2026, subject to customary conditions. Financial terms were not disclosed.
The deal brings C2i’s expertise in software-defined power management, multiphase controllers and system-level power architectures into Infineon’s much larger semiconductor portfolio. A multiphase controller coordinates several power-conversion stages to deliver high currents with fast response, while software-defined power uses digital control to adjust power delivery as operating conditions change.
The importance of that capability is tied directly to the rapid expansion of AI computing. The International Energy Agency estimates that data centres consumed about 415 TWh of electricity globally in 2024, around 1.5% of worldwide electricity use. In its base case, that figure is projected to more than double to about 945 TWh by 2030, with AI a major driver. Accelerated servers, which are predominantly used for AI workloads, are expected to account for almost half of the net increase in data-centre electricity consumption over the period.
For Infineon, the acquisition therefore fits into a broader effort to address power delivery across the data-centre system instead of treating it as a collection of separate components.
“This acquisition will further strengthen Infineon’s leadership in power solutions for AI data centers and create a new center of excellence for digital power technologies in India,” Adam White, President of Infineon’s Power Systems division, said, adding that C2i’s expertise would help accelerate work on next-generation vertical power delivery architectures.
Vertical power delivery is an emerging approach in which voltage regulation is moved physically closer to the processor. This can shorten electrical paths and help deal with the high current and rapid load changes associated with modern AI accelerators.
Infineon said the combination could advance work on Substrate Integrated Voltage Regulators (SIVRs), which integrate voltage regulation more closely with the processor package.
The development comes amid a wider shift in data-centre architecture. NVIDIA has been promoting 800 VDC (800-volt direct-current distribution), for future AI infrastructure, noting that higher-voltage distribution can reduce current, cabling requirements and conversion losses. NVIDIA said in August that it has been developing the architecture with Google, Microsoft and the Open Compute Project.
Infineon has also been expanding its own portfolio. In June, it announced server power designs supporting 18 kW and 30 kW power levels for high-voltage AI data-centre architectures. Earlier in the year it introduced new digital multiphase controllers and a high-current-density power module aimed at next-generation AI processors.
C2i is a young company by semiconductor industry standards. Incorporated in Bengaluru in 2024, it was founded by a team of semiconductor veterans and raised $15 million in Series A funding in February 2026. It has focused on power-management technologies for AI servers and cloud infrastructure.
Infineon said it has around 2,800 employees in India and plans to use the acquisition to strengthen the country as an R&D base for digital power technology. That aligns with India’s wider push to build domestic semiconductor design and manufacturing capabilities through initiatives including the India Semiconductor Mission and its Design Linked Incentive scheme.
“Joining Infineon gives us access to world-class semiconductor technologies, manufacturing capabilities, and global customer relationships,” C2i founder and CEO Ram Anant said.

articles.title: À quoi sert le code caché que Paint glisse dans chaque image générée par IA ?
articles.text:
Un chercheur a démonté le fonctionnement de Paint et Photos. Chaque image générée par IA y embarque un identifiant unique, émis par les serveurs de Microsoft et relié à la requête.
Paint traîne depuis quarante ans une réputation d'outil inoffensif, celui qu'on ouvre pour recadrer une capture d'écran ou griffonner une flèche rouge sur un plan. Le logiciel a discrètement changé de nature en accueillant la génération d'images par intelligence artificielle. Un travail de rétro-ingénierie publié par le chercheur Xusheng Li vient de montrer ce qui se passe sous le capot. Chaque image produite par Paint ou par l'application Photos sort de la machine avec un identifiant unique incrusté dans ses pixels, délivré par les serveurs de Microsoft et associé à la requête.
Deux couches de marquage pour une même image
Il faut distinguer plusieurs choses qui se ressemblent. Le filigrane visible, ce petit logo apposé dans un coin, Microsoft le documente depuis longtemps pour Microsoft 365 et Bing Image Creator, et l'utilisateur peut le voir. Le marquage invisible dans les pixels n'a rien d'inédit non plus, Google le pratique avec SynthID depuis 2024 et revendique des dizaines de milliards de contenus estampillés. L'élément nouveau tient à la nature de ce qui est inscrit : un identifiant global unique, un entier de 16 octets, émis par le serveur au moment de la génération.
Le mécanisme fonctionne à deux étages qui se répondent. Dans les pixels d'abord, avec la technologie Microsoft InvisMark, invisible à l'œil et robuste à la compression. Dans les métadonnées du fichier ensuite, sous la forme d'un manifeste conforme au standard ouvert C2PA, cette norme de provenance portée par une alliance regroupant Adobe, Microsoft, Google, OpenAI et Meta. Ce manifeste contient une déclaration cryptographiquement signée par Microsoft qui nomme explicitement InvisMark et enregistre l'identifiant transporté par le filigrane pixel. Les deux couches appartiennent donc au même système, ce que la documentation grand public ne laissait pas franchement deviner.
Le détail qui donne au sujet une autre dimension concerne le chaînage. Paint transmet l'identifiant de la génération précédente lors de la requête de modération suivante, ce qui permet de relier explicitement des demandes successives entre elles. Autrement dit, une série d'images créées au fil d'une session ne constitue pas une collection de fichiers indépendants aux yeux du système, mais une suite ordonnée rattachée à un même parcours.
L'AI Act demandait moins que ça
L'article 50 du règlement européen sur l'intelligence artificielle est entré en application le 2 août 2026. Il impose de marquer les contenus générés artificiellement dans un format lisible par une machine et détectable comme tel. Le texte parle de transparence sur l'origine synthétique du contenu, pas de traçabilité de son auteur. Un simple drapeau « cette image vient d'une IA » satisfait l'obligation, et c'est d'ailleurs le niveau auquel se situent la plupart des dispositifs actuels.
- Interface simple et intuitive
- Faible consommation de ressources
- Rapide pour retouches basiques
Le code de bonnes pratiques sur la transparence, publié par le bureau européen de l'IA le 10 juin 2026, va plus loin. Il recommande d'éviter d'inclure des informations sensibles pour la vie privée dans les métadonnées de provenance. Ce document reste volontaire et ne s'accompagne d'aucune sanction à ce stade, mais il indique la direction que prend la réflexion européenne sur le sujet. Un identifiant relié à une requête individuelle occupe précisément la zone que ce texte suggère d'éviter.
Comment expliquer un tel écart entre l'obligation et la pratique ? La lutte contre les usages malveillants fournit une réponse plausible, un identifiant par génération permettant de remonter à la source d'une image problématique bien plus efficacement qu'un marqueur générique. Microsoft n'a pas répondu dans l'immédiat à la sollicitation du média britannique The Register, et l'entreprise n'a pour l'heure publié aucune explication sur la finalité de ce numéro. Le chercheur relève surtout que baptiser cette fonction « informations d'identification du contenu » reste exact sur le fond, mais ne rend pas l'existence de l'identifiant évidente pour un utilisateur de Windows.
Une donnée personnelle ? La question reste ouverte
Le règlement européen sur la protection des données définit la donnée personnelle comme toute information se rapportant à une personne identifiée ou identifiable, y compris par un identifiant en ligne. La CNIL insiste de son côté sur l'identification indirecte : un numéro qui ne dit rien par lui-même devient une donnée personnelle dès lors qu'il permet, par recoupement, de singulariser une personne. Un identifiant émis par un serveur, associé à une requête et potentiellement à un compte, coche plusieurs cases de cette grille de lecture.
La conclusion mérite toutefois d'être maniée avec prudence. Aucune autorité de protection des données n'a été saisie du dossier à ce jour, aucune qualification juridique n'a été prononcée, et rien n'indique que Microsoft exploite ces identifiants pour remonter à des utilisateurs. La possibilité technique existe, son usage effectif relève pour l'instant de l'hypothèse. C'est une nuance que les commentaires enflammés repérés sur les forums techniques ont tendance à écraser, avec cette certitude un peu rapide que tout identifiant serait forcément un outil de surveillance.
Le contexte industriel donne malgré tout du relief à l'affaire. Meta a présenté son propre filigrane invisible Content Seal, incompatible avec les deux standards concurrents, et OpenAI applique le SynthID de Google à ses images tout en ajoutant des métadonnées C2PA. Chaque acteur bâtit son propre système de provenance avec ses propres choix sur ce qu'il inscrit dedans. L'utilisateur, lui, en découvre le contenu par les travaux de chercheurs plutôt que par les pages de documentation.

articles.title: SpaceX baut Weltraumbahnhof für 100 Milliarden Dollar
articles.text:
Tausende Starts pro Jahr: SpaceX plant neuen Weltraumbahnhof für 100 Milliarden Dollar
Sieben Jahre lang hat SpaceX eigenen Angaben zufolge nach einem geeigneten Areal für seinen geplanten neuen Weltraumbahnhof gesucht. Einen Standort, der ausreichend Platz für die geplanten Startrampen und den benötigten Treibstoff bietet, hat Elon Musks Raumfahrtfirma jetzt im US-Bundesstaat Louisiana gefunden.
Weltraumbahnhof an der Golfküste
Wie die für die Ansiedlung neuer Unternehmen zuständige Behörde Louisiana Economic Development gemeinsam mit SpaceX mitteilte, soll der Weltraumbahnhof im County Vermilion Parish am Golf von Mexiko errichtet werden. Dort sollen künftig tausende Raketenstarts pro Jahr möglich sein.
SpaceX hat angekündigt, bis zu 100 Milliarden Dollar in die Hand nehmen zu wollen. Tausende Jobs sollen in den kommenden Jahren in der wenig entwickelten Region geschaffen werden – inklusive hoher Gehälter, die weit über dem vor Ort üblichen Niveau liegen.
SpaceX will neue Anlage ab 2027 bauen
Mit den Bauarbeiten will der Konzern 2027 beginnen. Für 2029 sind die ersten Raketenstarts vorgesehen. „Wir bereiten den Bau eines Weltraumbahnhofs vor, der bisher nur in der Science-Fiction existierte“, so SpaceX-Gründer und CEO Musk. Den Startplatz nannte er „einen der inspirierendsten Orte unseres Planeten“.
Zuvor hatte sich SpaceX bereiterklärt, in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Bundesstaat eine Küstenrenaturierung zu realisieren. Dabei soll das Marschland wiederhergestellt und sichergestellt werden, das die Feuchtgebiete rund um die neue Anlage vor Stürmen geschützt sind, wie CNBC schreibt.
Kritik an Umweltverstößen in Texas
An seinem ersten Standort, der Starbase-Gemeinde mit Weltraumbahnhof, Raketenfabrik und dem Dorf Boca Chica in Texas, war SpaceX aufgrund von Umweltverstößen mit Klagen und Geldstrafen konfrontiert worden. Zudem gab es teils heftige Kritik aus der Bevölkerung.
Beim ersten Testflug seiner Starship-Rakete war die Startrampe explodiert und das Raumschiff in der Luft verglüht. Betonbrocken waren in ein nahegelegenes Nist- und Wandergebiet gestürzt. Außerdem hatten die Explosionen einen Waldbrand ausgelöst. Zudem soll SpaceX auf seiner Startanlage in Texas wiederholt gegen den Clean Water Act des Bundesstaats verstoßen haben.

articles.title: Los controles de Sánchez tras el pulso con Meloni detectan ya 8.216 viajeros de terceros países llegados desde Italia
articles.text:
España ha desplegado 1.219 agentes de Policía en 14 aeropuertos para controlar a 8.216 viajeros de terceros países que han lleggado desde Italia en apenas 2 semanas. La semana pasada ya eran más de 4.000. Italia, que prendió la mecha suspendiendo Schengen con España, ha logrado en el mismo periodo rechazar a 21 personas. Esa desproporción entre ruido político y resultado real resume en qué se ha convertido esta crisis. Y hoy mismo, 25 de agosto, la Comisión Europea ha confirmado que estudia si esos controles españoles vulneran el derecho comunitario.
Entretanto, Pedro Sánchez ha convocado por primera vez al Consejo de Seguridad Nacional para tratar específicamente la crisis. El Gobierno ha decretado la "situación de interés para la Seguridad Nacional" en Ceuta y ha creado un mando único, encabezado por el ministro Ángel Víctor Torres, que integrará también a la Delegación del Gobierno, el CNI y Juan Jesús Vivas como presidente ceutí.
Por qué existe Schengen. El Acuerdo de Schengen se firmó el 14 de junio de 1985 en un pueblo de Luxemburgo junto al río Mosela, por Alemania, Francia, Bélgica, Países Bajos y Luxemburgo. La idea era simple: suprimir las fronteras internas y dejar circular a las personas y mercancías sin control extra. Cuarenta años después, el espacio cubre 29 países y a más de 400 millones de personas. Al ser un pilar simbólico de la construcción europea, junto al euro, alterarlo supone una declaración política que rompe con cuatro décadas de consenso.
Tragedia primero, arma diplomática después. Entre 60.000 y 80.000 personas cruzaron a Ceuta desde Marruecos el 30 y 31 de julio, con al menos 72 muertos por ahogamiento (declarados por el Gobierno, AMDH sostiene que han sido 141). La presidenta Giorgia Meloni calificó la situación de amenaza a la seguridad europea y, el 31 de julio, suspendió unilateralmente Schengen con España "por el tiempo necesario".
España respondió mediante la Orden INT/846/2026, restableciendo controles temporales a todo vuelo o enlace marítimo procedente de Italia. Mismos aeropuertos —Barcelona, Madrid, Málaga, Sevilla, Valencia—, mismo pretexto de "presión migratoria irregular". Algo más de 2 semanas después, el resultado es la cifra que abre este texto: 8.216 controlados en España frente a apenas 21 rechazados en Italia.
Miedo proyectado. Recordemos que Ceuta y Melilla tienen un estatus diferenciado dentro del propio tratado. Quien entra de forma irregular en cualquiera de las dos ciudades autónomas no puede circular libremente por el resto de España ni por el espacio Schengen; debe superar un control adicional antes de desplazarse a la Península. Los controles cruzados que ahora se cobran en aeropuertos italianos y españoles responden a un temor —la "fuga" automática de irregulares hacia el resto de Europa— que el propio reglamento ya impedía de partida.
El bumerán, por países. La normativa europea de asilo establece que el primer país de entrada a la UE es responsable de tramitar la solicitud del migrante. Alemania fue la primera en activar esa regla contra la propia Italia a comienzos de agosto, exigiendo aplicación estricta del pacto migratorio europeo. Le siguieron Suiza, Austria, Finlandia, Suecia, Países Bajos e Irlanda, que se sumó este mismo fin de semana.
Siete países europeos preparan ya devoluciones de solicitantes de asilo hacia Italia, invocando la misma lógica de "primer país de entrada" que Meloni usó contra España. Austria y Suecia ya han ejecutado las primeras devoluciones. Elly Schlein, líder de la oposición italiana, dijo que "El bumerán de la ocurrencia propagandística de Meloni es escandaloso".
Qué dicen los datos. Entre 2021 y 2026 entraron en Italia unos 470.000 irregulares, cifra que sitúa la indignación de Meloni con Ceuta en una entelequia. Frontex, la Agencia Europea de la Guardia de Fronteras y Costas constató una caída del 37% en entradas irregulares en el primer semestre de 2026. Las rutas del Mediterráneo oriental y central concentran más del 60% del total de llegadas irregulares, mientras la ruta de África occidental (la de Canarias) ha registrado el mayor descenso, con una caída del 67% interanual.
Una historia de desamor. La relación entre Washington y Madrid supone un buen telón de fondo ante semejante teatro. En marzo, tras el veto español al uso de las bases de Rota y Morón para una eventual ofensiva contra Irán, Trump respaldó abiertamente la propuesta del senador Lindsey Graham de retirar todas las tropas estadounidenses de España, llamando "cobardes" a los aliados que no colaboraban en la seguridad del estrecho de Ormuz.
Desde España, el "socio terrible", escuchábamos a Trump lanzar una nueva amenaza ligada al 5% del PIB en defensa que España se negaba a asumir, señalando a Rota y Morón como "activos negociables" por primera vez desde el convenio bilateral de 1988. El embajador de EEUU ante la OTAN llegó a decir en julio que Trump estaba "decepcionado" con España.
El mismo Donald Trump que llamó "woke" a Claude siguió repitiendo amenazas por el escaso gasto militar español, si bien las cifras revelan un aumento del 50 % respecto a 2025, alcanzando los 34.265 millones de euros, según informe del Instituto Internacional de Estocolmo para la Investigación de la Paz (SIPRI). La cumbre de Ankara reforzó un amor marcado por amenazas recurrentes sobre activos estratégicos como el control efectivo del estrecho de Gibraltar.
El sueño de los 100 millones de turistas. Entretanto, los números no salen. España cerró 2025 con 96,8 millones de turistas extranjeros e iba camino de superar por primera vez los 100 millones en 2026, con 46,5 millones de viajeros solo en el primer semestre, un 4,6% más que el año anterior. Junio mostró síntomas de frenazo por el calor; la crisis fronteriza extendida hasta el 7 de septiembre está haciendo el resto.
Miles de pasajeros llegados de Italia siguen sufriendo retrasos por controles de identidad, pasaporte y, en el caso de terceros países, revisión de visado. Una fricción diplomática que afecta a quienes menos culpa tienen. Porque, al parecer, Italia sigue sin pensar en retirar sus controles. Mientras 7 países europeos presionan a Roma con la misma arma que Roma usó contra Madrid, se estima que del gran éxodo espoleado por Marruecos apenas quedan dos mil personas en suelo español. El líder de la oposición exige la devolución de "todos". Abascal clama por una "Europa blanca".
El Gobierno, en paralelo, arranca una semana de comparecencias parlamentarias: 7 ministros desfilarán por el Congreso, empezando por la ministra de Defensa, Margarita Robles y su declaración de “españolidad”, y cerrando el lunes 31 con Sira Rego. Entre las medidas sobre la mesa figuran agilizar las devoluciones a Marruecos, trasladar a la Península a 500 menores no acompañados y ayudas económicas para los comercios ceutíes, que arrastran semanas de pérdidas.

articles.title: Oubliez 2027, les Apple AirPods 5 arriveraient finalement dans quelques jours
articles.text:
Oubliez 2027, les Apple AirPods 5 arriveraient finalement dans quelques jours
Les AirPods 5 pourraient débarquer dès septembre, bien plus tôt que prévu. Deux déclinaisons seraient au programme, avec une possible surprise de taille : l’arrivée de la très attendue puce H3.
Apple pourrait finalement accélérer le calendrier de renouvellement de ses AirPods, habituellement mis à jour tous les trois ans. D’après le toujours bien informé Mark Gurman, la marque à la pomme préparerait la présentation des AirPods 5 dès la keynote de rentrée, attendue le 9 septembre 2026. Une commercialisation bien plus rapide que prévu, alors que les premières anticipations tablaient plutôt sur une sortie en 2027.
Deux références découvertes dans macOS Tahoe 26.7
Le journaliste de Bloomberg s’appuie sur la découverte de deux nouveaux modèles dans le code de la Release Candidate de macOS Tahoe 26.7. Identifiés sous les références B868M et B868E, ils reprennent une nomenclature très proche de celle des AirPods 4, qui étaient référencés B867M et B867E. Apple devrait donc conserver une gamme composée d’une version classique et d’une déclinaison équipée d’un système de réduction active du bruit.
L’arrivée de la puce H3 dès septembre ?
Même si les AirPods 5 devraient logiquement profiter de diverses optimisations, la principale zone d’ombre concerne l’intégration de la très attendue puce H3. Son développement aurait bien débuté chez Apple et pourrait apporter des améliorations en matière de qualité sonore et de latence.
Il convient toutefois de rester prudent à ce stade, car rien ne permet d’affirmer que les AirPods 5 en seront équipés. Les informations disponibles évoquent avant tout un projet matériel en cours, sans préciser son niveau d’avancement ni confirmer son intégration à cette nouvelle génération.
Apple travaillerait aussi sur un capteur capable de mesurer la température corporelle. Là encore, cette information est à prendre avec précaution, même si une telle fonction pourrait s’inscrire dans la stratégie de suivi de la santé qu’Apple développe autour de ses écouteurs. En revanche, le suivi de la fréquence cardiaque devrait rester exclusif aux AirPods Pro 3.
Des tarifs potentiellement inchangés
Les AirPods 5 pourraient ainsi reprendre les tarifs actuels, avec une version standard autour de 149 € et une déclinaison équipée d’un système de réduction du bruit à 199 €. Quant aux AirPods Pro dotés de caméras, destinés notamment à renforcer les fonctions d’intelligence visuelle, ils ne seraient pas attendus avant 2027, malgré l’extraction récente d’une vidéo officielle les mettant en scène depuis macOS Tahoe 26.7.
Si Apple confirme bien les AirPods 5 en septembre, l’enjeu sera donc moins leur simple arrivée que les technologies finalement retenues. La principale question concernera notamment la puce H3, dont l’existence paraît crédible, mais dont la présence au sein de cette nouvelle génération reste encore loin d’être acquise.

articles.title: BBG Entertainment Announces a Reboot of the Classic Game MANIC MINER
articles.text:
Tuesday, August 25th 2026
	
	
	
	
BBG Entertainment Announces a Reboot of the Classic Game MANIC MINER
BBG Entertainment, the Munich-based publisher behind the acclaimed remakes of BOULDER DASH, ASTROSMASH, and SHARK! SHARK!, is bringing one of gaming's most influential platformers back to life: MANIC MINER - the cult classic that defined a whole generation of home computer gaming - will be released this autumn for PlayStation 4/5, Xbox Series X/S, Nintendo Switch, Steam, Windows, and Mac.
Authorized by MANIC MINER creator Matthew Smith, the reboot combines the charm of the 1983 original with modern graphics, revamped controls, a newly recorded soundtrack, and an extensive behind-the-scenes archive. Unlike many of the original game's previous releases, this authorized edition ensures that Matthew Smith, who has rarely seen significant revenue from his creation despite its huge success, will properly participate in the proceeds from every copy sold.MANIC MINER is considered a milestone of the early home computer era. Developed by Matthew Smith, the title captivated players upon its 1983 launch with precise gameplay, a high level of difficulty, and its unique level design.
The development team wanted to preserve the DNA while introducing the classic to a new generation of gamers: First, the original code was reconstructed with pixel-perfect accuracy. This became the foundation for carefully modernizing the levels that drove a whole generation of computer game players to the verge of despair.
All 20 original levels are fully included in two distinct styles:
The controls have been completely overhauled for modern platforms, delivering precise, fluid gameplay that respects the original's notoriously high difficulty while making it significantly more accessible to new players. But beware, this game won't go easy on you!
Classic Soundtrack Reborn:
The iconic classical compositions by Johann Strauss and Edvard Grieg have been re-arranged in a contemporary style, giving the game a fresh, high-quality sound that honors its heritage.
The Definitive MANIC MINER Archive:
Fans and history buffs can explore an extensive interactive history tracing the game's development from its early 1980s concepts, through its rise to cult status, to today's re-release.
Featuring concept art, historical graphics, and fascinating insights behind the scenes, this is the most comprehensive look at MANIC MINER ever made available.
And yes…for those who remember the original's most infamous resident: Eugene the toilet monster is back and ready to frustrate a new generation of players.Hans Ippisch, producer of the MANIC MINER reboot, explains:
"Manic Miner was a smash hit in 1983... one that influenced generations of players and developers. For my team and me, bringing back this cult classic is a huge honor. And personally, I'm very happy we can ensure that Matthew Smith will properly share in the success of this reboot."
